official manager refreshes stale raw-head world matrix through actual parent ancestry
gravity stays world-down under a rotated head center
removing one manager joint leaves another manager using the same head center functional
separate actor heads own separate inverse caches

limits: Object3D/Bone fixtures use the installed official manager and joint. They do not replay actual captured avatar motion or establish visible naturalness.
No original avatar animation, hair mesh, chair collision or browser is exercised in these semantics checks. Candidate identity and loading are reviewed separately.

Center setter instruments its matrixWorld.elements through a shared inverseCacheProxy. deleteJoint does not release that instrumentation. No per-joint center=null cleanup is attempted because it would remove a shared cache still used by another joint.
